name: Diana Rusu
technologyLevel: Intermediate (comfortable with tech, not an early adopter)
goals:
Use Gamar to track her own performance stats across sessions to improve and post highlights on TikTok.
Use the AR overlay to monitor community trends and patch notes passively while she streams, without interrupting her commentary.
Use the Smartwatch to get discreet session reminders so she doesn't lose track of time during long streams.
frustrations:
Having to alt-tab to check patch notes or tier lists mid-game breaks her flow and ruins stream quality.
Feeling like she's always behind on meta changes compared to the hardcore players in her community.
Missing time-sensitive community events or tournaments because notifications get buried in her phone.
scenarios:
During a stream, Diana glances at her AR overlay to pull up live community tier list updates without interrupting her commentary or tabbing out.
Her Smartwatch taps her wrist after 2 hours to remind her to take a break, which she mentions on stream as part of her 'healthy gaming' brand.
otherDetails:
Personality: Outgoing, community-driven, brand-conscious.
Preferences: Clean minimal UI, prefers pastel or neutral aesthetics over neon, values anything that looks good on camera.
